caption: Cheerful children's nursery song for preschool TV, playful duet between a sweet bright female voice (Ziggy the cat) and a happy warm male voice (Waffles the dog), bright ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy bass and light drums, catchy sing-along chorus, happy, major key, polished modern kids music production
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Meow, meow, Ziggy's here!
Twitch your whiskers, wiggle your ears!
Woof, woof, Waffles too,
Wagging my tail just for you!

[Chorus]
We're the Paws and Claws Club, hey hey hey!
We sing and we dance and we play all day!
Paws up high and tails down low,
Paws and Claws Club, here we go!
